description:
Find accommodations across the ATA Travel Network with real-time pricing. Use when dates are known. Supports filtering by amenities, views, property type, and free-text keyword to handle vague requests.
Default next step for a useful comparison: show_available_rooms with returned IDs and unchanged criteria; do not wait for a photo request or repeat this search just to render. One view after final results; skip unsupported UI, text-only preferences, no priced offers, legacy maxPrice caps and already-visible comparisons.

amenities.description: Filter by amenities on property or rooms. e.g. ['Pool', 'Gym', 'Pet Friendly', 'Spa']

budget.description: Optional additional budget constraint. Clarify missing currency or basis before calling. Do not combine with legacy maxPrice/maxPriceCurrency.

amount.description: Maximum amount in the explicitly supplied currency and basis.

basis.description: Required explicit basis. Per-night means a stay-average allowance, not a ceiling on each night. Per-person means every adult and child equally; clarify other interpretations.

currency.description: Required 3-letter budget currency. Never infer from location or displayCurrency.

scope.description: PRICED_STAY compares the accommodation total including configured taxes/fees. ALL_IN requires complete mandatory charges; currently ATA cannot verify completeness and will return labeled alternatives only.

displayCurrency.description: Optional 3-letter currency for approximate traveler-facing display conversion. Native property currency remains authoritative.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword matched against property name/description. Great for vibe searches like 'boutique', 'beachside', 'romantic'.

location.description: Optional city, state, or country. Omit when the traveler knows dates but is open to ATA's current destinations.

maxPriceCurrency.description: Currency for maxPrice when filtering across mixed property currencies. If omitted, maxPrice is compared to each property's native currency.

preferences.description: Open-ended soft ranking signals. These do not exclude otherwise valid stays.

name: search_network_availability
